newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Centrica valued at 40p.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Centrica valued at 40p.

text.p: Analysts at Merrill Lynch on Monday set a "fair value" price of 40p on Centrica Plc, the demerged natural gas trading arm of British Gas Plc, market sources said on Monday.
Analysts at Merrill were not immediately available for comment.

The stock, which formally began trading today after the demerger was last week approved by British Gas shareholders, was down 8-1/4p at 67-1/4 from Friday's "grey market" price in active trading of 2.8 million shares.
BG Plc, the other demerged stock from British Gas, was up 3p at 173-1/2 in volume of 1.5 million shares with dealers saying there were signs of switching from Centrica into BG.

Other analysts were also negative on Centrica shares at their current levels. Elizabeth Butler of Panmure Gordon said U.S. investors were likely to be sellers of the stock since it had no listing in the United States.
Dealers said analysts at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett said the stock should be bought at 35p and sold at 65p. Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.
